5 تفيّل : see 1. ＝
-A2- Also He (a man, K, [or a camel, as is indicated in the O,]) became fat, (O, K,) as though he were a فِيل [or an elephant]. (O.) [See also 10.] ―
-b2- And, said of youth, or young manhood, (الشَّبَاب,) It increased, (Lth, T, M, O, K,) and became in its prime and fulness. (Lth, T, O.) ―
-b3- And, said of herbage, It became tall, and full-grown; or became of its full height, and blossomed. (Th, M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
